items.title: United Parcel Service (UPS) Opens $80 Million Philippines Air Hub As Asia Trade Shifts
items.summary: United Parcel Service (NYSE:UPS) is investing more than US$80 million in a new air hub in the Philippines to scale its Asian logistics network. The facility is being developed at Clark International Airport and is intended to serve as a regional air gateway for shifting intra Asia trade routes. UPS plans to use the Philippine hub to support customers moving manufacturing and sourcing closer to key end markets.
